Name: (CP) Donut's Seasonal Anime East Scarp Portraits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
Hello guys, This mod replaces all portraits included in Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp with Portraits designed to fit in line with Anime-styled Portraits closely following OhoDavi's designs. This is done using Content Patcher so no need to replace existing files within SCC for East Scarp with mine.

Some of these portrait's base designs were made by me with tweaks made as I got better with drawing so you may notice differences from the Base East Scarp Anime mod of mine.

You will still need some of the base portraits for NPCs such as Eyvinder and Beatrice who had built-in Seasonal Outfits as well as NPC's not included in the Seasonal Outfits Mod. You can find them in my original mod here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25958]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25958

[/url]I've yet to play much of East Scarp's Story so if there are any issues please inform me in comments or bugs section

Finally, I didn't make all the base designs as many featured are from the talented [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bunzbunzMODS]bunzbunzMODS[/url] in their original mod that had originally inspired me to start work on east scarp to begin with:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17838]East Scarp Anime Portraits Replacer[/url]

Downloads.Description: Content Patcher mod should be able to be dragged and dropped into Mods folder within Stardew Valley and work flawlessly.
